form.title: Send feedback
form.sub: An idea, a bug, something that bugs you. It goes straight to the people building zerosoft.

placeholder.idea: What would make this better for you?
placeholder.bug: What happened, and what did you expect? Steps to reproduce help a lot.

form.emailHint: Only if you want a reply. We don't add it to any list.
form.successBody: We review it and, if it fits, it shows up on the board for others to vote on.
form.successBodySignedIn: We review it and, if it fits, it shows up on the board for others to vote on. Until then you'll find it on the board, under your requests under review.
form.errorInvalid: Write at least a few words (and check the email, if you added one).
form.errorRate: Too many messages in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
form.errorGeneric: Couldn't send it. Try again, or email hola@zerosoft.ai.

page.metaDescription: Send an idea, a bug report or anything else to the team building zerosoft.ai.
page.label: Feedback
page.title: Tell us what to fix.
page.intro: zerosoft is built in the open and shaped by the people who use it. No account needed.
page.aside1: Every message lands in our inbox and gets read by a person.
page.aside2: Bugs get fixed first. Ideas go into the roadmap discussion.
page.aside3: Shipped changes show up in the changelog.

admin.title: Feedback
admin.sub: Messages sent from the app and the website. Only visible to ADMIN_EMAILS.
